description: The yard's outbound and inbound work. Picking & shipping: what has to go out, by date and yard, late first; release fixed-asset lines, the pick slip, Pick and ship. Receiving & returns: what is coming back and what has arrived; Receive at yard, and a unit back without notice (scan or type its serial). Steps that write to Fusion (transfer order release, return transfer orders, maintenance-asset moves) are shown and left to New EquipRite.
